messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: routing-policy anomaly detected. Automatic alert: 12:43 UTC. Symptom: sudden uptick in model-output-errors + user-facing mismatches for a subset of hosted routes. Affected service: smart-routing (control-plane config svc). Pager notified: @oncall-sre, @ops-liam. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2623

oncall-sre: I'm on it. paging in community channel and starting triage. Can someone confirm the exact config roll that went out around 12:30?

ops-liam: I saw a config-schema migration deploy at 12:27 from `config-service` (release 2026.03.15). It removed deprecated field `variant_preference` and introduced `routing_defaults` with a new implicit behavior when fields are missing. Suspect default mapping changed behavior.

eng-jordan: Observed traffic traces: requests that used to target `redwood-model-large-v2` are now falling fallback to `redwood-model-mini-q4` in region eu-west due to the new defaulting logic. Error rate (EMBED_ERR) jumped from 0.4% -> 7.8% for those routes.

pm-alex: Customer impact: CS flagged 3 enterprise tenants reporting hallucinations and one customer reported increased 503s. We may need to open a Sev2 if rollback is slow.

cs-jen: Confirmed: Tenant "AcmePayments" reported incorrect transaction descriptions from LLM, started at ~12:42. Support tickets: #5491, #5493. I've notified their CSM and offered mitigation guidance.

oncall-sre: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Apply temporary routing-override to pin affected routes to `redwood-model-large-v2` across regions. 2) Revert config-schema rollout or patch mapping to preserve old semantics. 3) Notify customers and update status page. Assigning tasks: @ops-liam do (1), @devex-priya coordinate rollback path, @sre-lead draft comms.

ops-liam: Applying override now. Patch payload: ```
POST /v1/routing/overrides
{
  "match": {
    "route_id": "acme_*",
    "region": "*"
  },
  "override": {
    "model_variant": "redwood-model-large-v2",
    "force": true
  },
  "ttl": 3600
}
```

ops-liam: Override applied, control plane acknowledged. Monitoring propagation to edge nodes. :thumbsup:

eng-jordan: Saw propagation start ~12:50, by 12:53 traffic to the pinned variant for affected routes increased to expected levels and error rate dropped to ~1.2%. Good signal.

devex-priya: For rollback: we have two options: 1) Back out schema change in config-service (fast but risky if other services rely on new fields). 2) Add a compatibility shim that maps missing `variant_preference` -> explicit `routing_defaults` that match previous behavior. I recommend (2) to avoid cluster-wide churn.

oncall-sre: Agreed. Do shim + audit script. Priya, can you author mapping and push a hotfix?

devex-priya: Working on a patch. Patch will apply a migration that: - copies `variant_preference` into `routing_defaults.model_variant` when present; - if missing, uses the explicit previous default `redwood-model-large-v2` for hosted API routes. Test plan: unit tests + one-region canary.

eng-jordan: Quick note: root cause summary for postmortem: a schema migration removed a deprecated field without an explicit migration step. The config engine now treats an absent field as "prefer cheapest compatible variant" which caused safe routes to pick a smaller quantized variant. That variant is incompatible with some prompt sets leading to hallucinations.

cs-jen: Customer update drafted and sent to affected tenants (AcmePayments, FlowMetrics, NovaSaas). We offered temporary rate-limited replays and a post-mortem. They acknowledged.

ops-liam: Hotfix deployed (compat-shim v1.0.1) to control-plane at 13:05. Migration ran and mapped legacy semantics. Rolling canary to eu-west then global.

eng-jordan: Canary metrics: eu-west stable for 15m, error rate at baseline. Global roll started at 13:22.

sre-lead: Handoff: @oncall-sre handing to @ops-liam for mitigation verification and to monitor until 15:00 UTC. I'll remain on-call for comms and postmortem kickoff.

oncall-sre: Acknowledged handoff. Logging final action items: - Confirm no remaining pinned overrides after shim fully rolled out (ops-liam) - Add automated migration check to deploy pipeline (devex-priya) - Customer-facing timeline + root cause draft (sre-lead + cs-jen) - Postmortem to include schema-deprecation checklist and gating for implicit defaults (eng-jordan).

cs-jen: Impact summary for postmortem: 12 affected customers, 4 support tickets with degraded output, 2 customers escalated to CSMs. No data exfiltration, no production job failures. We estimate ~40 minutes of user-visible impact for most.

pm-alex: Risk note: we should add a CI check to forbid implicit defaulting on removed/deprecated fields. Will open a quick RFC.

eng-jordan: Also creating a small alert: `routing.policy.implcit_defaulting` triggered when a config deploy removes a deprecated key without migration mapping.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation confirmed. Auto-close window in 2h unless manually escalated. Summary: compatibility shim applied, per-route overrides removed after stable rollout, customers notified.

ops-liam: Removing temporary overrides now. Verified traffic continues to target `redwood-model-large-v2` where expected.

sre-lead: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline, RCA, mitigation, engineering changes, comms.

eng-jordan: Adding logs and traces to the incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2623/logs

cs-jen: Closing customer loop: CS follow-ups scheduled, internal runbook updated with 'schema deprecation migration' checklist.

oncall-sre: Closing thread. If any regression, reopen or ping pager. :white_check_mark:
